logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the Ir-PF-1–3/Ru-PF-1–3 was evaluated by determining their log Po/w using the shake-flask method. Ultrapure water and n-octanol were pre-saturated, and a 1:1 volume ratio mixture was prepared in an Erlenmeyer flask, which was then agitated for 48 hours to allow the two phases to equilibrate. Weighed amounts of the Ir-PF-1–3/Ru-PF-1–3 complexes were added to 15 mL centrifuge tubes, and 5 mL each of the saturated n-octanol and aqueous phases were introduced. The tubes were rapidly shaken at room temperature for 48 hours to facilitate partitioning. After centrifugation, the separated phases were collected for analysis.
